seed: fresh event frames; seed content excluded

config.pronunciation_source: NLTK CMUdict first deterministic stress-valid pronunciation
config.stress_constraints: 4--13 syllables, >=2 stress transitions, bounded strong-stress ratio
config.character_join: independent reverse tape index after prosodic filtering

next_repair_operator.name: stress_frontier_repair
next_repair_operator.action: At the best surviving outer-character frontier, replace one lexical realization with a held-out same-role lexeme of matching syllable/stress profile or move one legal phrase boundary; retain semantic frame and re-audit exactness independently.

reader_gate: No row is reader evidence; any exact row requires intact-prose versus shuffled-control blinded readers.
